name: Asian Insulators Public Company Limited
summary: Asian Insulators Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and distributes porcelain insulators products for electricity distribution and transmission lines. It offers spool, strain, line post type, pin post type, suspension, station post type, cleat, porcelain, and horizontal mounting solid core line post insulators; and underground cable support products. The company provides services for design, supply, and installation of high voltage substation, distribution, and transmission line systems; and project management, industrial maintenance, construction, and engineering services to the water, power, and communications industries. It is also involved in producing and distributing biodiesel, vegetable oil, and other fuel oil; and exporting vegetable oil under the Pamola brand. In addition, the company offers local and overseas logistics services for passenger, merchandise, parcel, and other materials; and ports and rental tank farms services. Further, it trades in electrical equipment. Asian Insulators Public Company Limited was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
